page_title: CAG 0-2 LEC | Cagliari v Lecce 16/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
90+6' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari). Cagliari force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+6' The ball is cleared after Nikola Stulic (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+3' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Elia Caprile makes a great save.
90+2' That will be all from Lassana Coulibaly who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Sadik Fofana (Lecce).
90+2' The injury to Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

88' What a great effort! Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
86' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Omri Gandelman will be replaced by Oumar Ngom (Lecce).
86' Today's match ends for Santiago Pierotti who will be replaced by Jamil Siebert (Lecce).
85' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
84' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
84' Jose Pedro (Cagliari) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Cagliari.
83' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.

83' Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Corrie Ndaba (Lecce) is coming onto the pitch as Riccardo Sottil cannot continue after picking up an injury.
80' Here comes a substitution. Nikola Stulic (Lecce) is brought on as a substitute for Walid Cheddira.
79' Fabio Pisacane prepares a substitution. Adam Obert is replaced by Yael Trepy (Cagliari).
79' Ermano Feliciani sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
77' Celebrations by Lecce are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
76' Goal! Great play by Lassana Coulibaly releases Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom left corner. 0:2.
75' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
75' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Ermano Feliciani saw the whole situation. Lecce will take a free kick near the side line.
73' A pass from Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) is intercepted by Elia Caprile and the move breaks down.
71' What a miss! The corner finds Adam Obert (Cagliari) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just over the bar.
71' Corner kick. Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is ready to send the ball into the box.

70' Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
68' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
68' Ermano Feliciani couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Danilo Veiga (Lecce) and blew his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Cagliari.
67' A pass from Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) is intercepted by Wladimiro Falcone and the move breaks down.

65' Perfectly taken free kick! Riccardo Sottil sends a cross in and Omri Gandelman (Lecce) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes into the bottom left corner and the score changes to 0:1.
62' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
62' Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul after Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Cagliari earn a free kick.
61' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) takes the corner which is cleared.
61' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
59' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Omri Gandelman (Lecce), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles away of the left post. Poor effort.

58' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom left corner. Elia Caprile shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
57' Substitution. Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) in, Gabriele Zappa out.
57' Fabio Pisacane has decided to substitute Leonardo Pavoletti and he is replaced by Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari).
56' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
52' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
51' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
50' Omri Gandelman (Lecce) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ermano Feliciani no option but to blow his whistle.
48' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' It looks like Marco Palestra (Cagliari) saw red with that tackle. Ermano Feliciani won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
41' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
40' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
40' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Cagliari.
39' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
38' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) blows a big chance to score! He slammed the ball from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it went narrowly over the crossbar.
36' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
35' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
35' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. Lecce win a corner kick.

34' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ermano Feliciani with no other option than to blow for a foul. Lecce win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
33' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
32' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) commits a rough foul. Ermano Feliciani stops the game and makes a call.
29' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
28' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes high over the bar.
28' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
26' Omri Gandelman (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.

23' That didn't go as planned! Walid Cheddira (Lecce) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Elia Caprile, who easily kept it out.
23' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
22' Ermano Feliciani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari). A free kick to Lecce.
20' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
19' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
19' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
15' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ermano Feliciani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
11' A cross from a corner kick by Cagliari is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
11' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Cagliari earn a corner.
6' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul.
4' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
3' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
3' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Now Cagliari have a corner.
1' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) was too forceful with his tackle and Ermano Feliciani interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Ermano Feliciani.
